description: Single labeled corpus shared by device (app/test) and server (api/test) SMS baselines. Each case records the desired end-state (expected) and the measured current behavior (baseline). Phase 0 asserts the baseline only; later phases flip assertions toward expected and may rewrite baseline.

cases.body: INR 1,250.50 debited from your A/c XX1234 on 16-10-26 for UPI-P2M to GROCERY_M. Avl bal Rs.8,750.25.

baseline.device: one spend transaction plus balance persisted as an observation field, not a typed fact
baseline.server: spend parsed with availableBalanceInr, no typed fact contract

cases.body: Your A/c XX9876 available balance is Rs.9,000.00 as on 16-10-26.

expected.note: recognized non-spend: should sync a typed balance fact, never terminally acknowledged before projection/sync

baseline.device: balance observation saved, typed balance_snapshot fact enqueued in the local outbox, then localIgnore acknowledges intake so /transactions/from-sms never sees it; the background drain uploads the typed fact
baseline.server: receives balance_only as a typed balance_snapshot fact via POST /sms/facts; no transaction row

cases.body: Your Axis Bank Credit Card XX4321 e-statement generated on 12-10-26. Total Amount Due INR 3,000.00, Minimum Amount Due INR 600.00, pay by 05-Nov-26.

expected.note: statement total, minimum due and due date must stay separate money/date roles

baseline.device: bill observation saved AND typed bill_obligation facts minted (due_total 3000 + due_minimum 600, due date Nov 5, statement date Oct 12, last4 4321) into the outbox; legacy batch sync unchanged
baseline.server: statement and due days heal via POST /sms/facts specialists; no transaction match from the pattern parser

cases.body: Your TNEB electricity bill of Rs.1,500 is due on 18-10-26. Pay on TNEB app and get Rs.100 cashback offer!

expected.note: a real bill wins over appended marketing language

baseline.device: bill observation with biller name 'TNEB electricity' and amount; offer clause ignored; typed bill_obligation due_total fact (1500) minted into the outbox; no spend
baseline.server: accepts the bill fact via POST /sms/facts; pattern parser still finds no transaction

cases.body: AutoPay e-mandate successfully registered for NETFLIX with maximum limit of INR 2,000.00 on HDFC Bank A/c XX1797

expected.note: mandate ceiling is not a charge and never becomes spend; should reach the server as a typed fact

baseline.device: autopay observation with the ceiling now extracted ('maximum limit of INR 2,000.00' matches), typed mandate_lifecycle registered fact (merchant NETFLIX, limit 2000, accountLast4 1797) enqueued in the outbox; intake localIgnore
baseline.server: typed fact accepted via POST /sms/facts and persisted as a subscription mandate with merchant NETFLIX and ceiling 2000

cases.body: Your Netflix AutoPay of INR 799 is scheduled for 17-10-26. The next payment due on 18-10-26.

baseline.device: no spend; kept as a bill-type observation because of the due phrase
baseline.server: no transaction match; subscription parser reads it as non_mandate_alert

cases.body: AutoPay payment for NETFLIX failed due to insufficient balance. No money was debited.

expected.note: failure is a distinct typed fact (renewal-at-risk signal), not disposable noise

baseline.device: capturesFinancialSms admits it; failed observation with localIgnore (no completed movement); typed pending_or_failed_attempt fact (biller NETFLIX) minted in the outbox
baseline.server: typed fact accepted via POST /sms/facts

cases.body: Your NETFLIX AutoPay mandate has been cancelled successfully on HDFC A/c XX1797.

baseline.device: captured as a terminal failed observation; typed mandate_lifecycle cancelled fact (merchant NETFLIX, accountLast4 1797) minted into the outbox; intake localIgnore
baseline.server: accepts the cancelled mandate via POST /sms/facts and persists the lifecycle through the injected mandate writer

cases.body: Your refund of Rs.499 was credited to credit card XX4321. Get 5% cashback on next purchase!

expected.note: refund is not earned income and not a promotion

baseline.device: credit-card credit recognized as a Refund transfer; offer clause ignored
baseline.server: conservative parser returns transfer/refund 499 on card 4321

cases.body: Rs.12,000.00 debited from your Axis Bank A/c XX8801 towards your Axis Bank Credit Card bill payment on 12-11-26.

expected.note: repayment is a transfer plus a bill settlement relationship, never a second purchase

baseline.device: transfer labeled Credit card bill payment
baseline.server: conservative parser returns transfer with card_bill kind, 12000

cases.body: INR 4,000.00 outstanding on your HDFC credit card XX4321 as on 10-11-26. Pay by 15-11-26 to avoid interest.

expected.note: outstanding updates the existing cycle without replacing the original statement total

baseline.device: no spend; lands as a generic unknown review item (no outstanding field exists)
baseline.server: no transaction match

cases.body: Kotak Neo: Running A/c settlement payout of INR 15,500.00 initiated for your demat account. You should receive funds in A/c XX1234 by EOD.

expected.note: investment settlement/proceeds observation; never consumer spend or earned income

baseline.device: no spend observation; generic unknown review item
baseline.server: no transaction match; broker settlement vocabulary does not include 'Kotak Neo'

cases.body: Transaction Check Alert! We tried to contact you twice to confirm the following txn: Rs.2,000.00 on Card XX4321 at AMAZON on 16-10-26. If this was not you, call 1860-266-2661

expected.note: verification alert: must never create a transaction review action or a posted spend

baseline.device: no local transaction; generic unknown review item (the screenshot false-review case)
baseline.server: conservative parser FALSE POSITIVE: posts a 2000 spend with merchant 'contact you twice to confirm the following'

cases.body: Rs.500.00 reversed back to your HDFC Bank A/c XX1234 on 16-10-26.

expected.note: reversal links to the original event; not earned income

baseline.device: transfer labeled Reversal
baseline.server: conservative parser returns transfer/reversal 500

cases.body: Rs.250 debited from A/c XX1234 to Sujay Enterprises via UPI on 16-10-26. Ref 123456789012

expected.note: payment to a person is a cost; a namesake store is not a self-transfer without wider profile-name evidence

baseline.device: spend, but the merchant capture swallows the account clause ('A/c XX1234 to Sujay Enterprises') instead of the payee; with ownUserName 'Sujay Kumar' it stays spend because one matching token is not enough
baseline.server: conservative parser returns spend with transferParty Sujay Enterprises and a junk merchant 'A/c XX1234 to Sujay Enterprises'-style clause

cases.body: Your account XX1234 credited INR 50000 as salary on 16-10-26.

expected.note: explicit earned income wording is the only automatic income classification

baseline.device: income transaction labeled Salary
baseline.server: conservative parser returns income entry

cases.body: Rs.20000 withdrawn from HDFC Bank Card x8406 at ATM on 13/10/26.

expected.note: own cash movement: excluded from spending, shown in cash flow

baseline.device: transfer labeled Cash withdrawal on debit card 8406
baseline.server: conservative parser returns transfer/cash_withdrawal

cases.body: Call Forwarding is now active on your Vodafone idea number.

expected.note: safely excluded with a recorded reason count, not silently dropped and never reviewed as a transaction

baseline.device: the transaction-only prefilter rejects it before capture
baseline.server: never receives it

cases.body: Get Rs.100 cashback when you spend Rs.15,000 on Paytm app recharge offers. Apply now!

expected.note: conditional offer language; no completed movement, no user review

baseline.device: prefilter promo words reject it
baseline.server: never receives it

cases.body: OTP 483921 for txn of Rs.2,500 on your HDFC card XX4321. Do not share.

expected.note: safety veto before persistence, AI or review; body must never leave the process

baseline.device: OTP/safety filter rejects before anything is written
baseline.server: never receives it

cases.body: INR 500 purchase declined on credit card XX4321.

expected.note: failed attempt is safe noise for spending; typed fact optional in a first release

baseline.device: capturesFinancialSms admits failed attempts; failed observation with localIgnore; typed pending_or_failed_attempt fact (INR 500, credit card) minted in the outbox
baseline.server: typed fact accepted via POST /sms/facts

cases.body: Rs.3,000 debited from HDFC Bank A/c XX9080 on 16-10-26 for balance transfer to another bank.

expected.note: paired with ambiguous_suffix_two_banks_second; same last four at two institutions must stay independent observations and never merge automatically

baseline.device: bank debit without a named recipient stays an ambiguous review item; suffix captured per observation
baseline.server: no transaction match (ambiguous account debit)

cases.body: Your Canara Bank account XX9080 was credited Rs.3,000 on 16-10-26 from HDFC Bank. Ref 908877665544.

expected.note: credit names both banks but no shared reference; automatic pairing must stay off until evidence clears the gates

baseline.device: credit from another bank is a transfer observation on the Canara leg only
baseline.server: conservative parser returns a transfer credit; no automatic pairing happens without a relationship feature
